For ITQ-22:
- Starting mixture composition: 0.66 SiO2:0.33 GeO2:0.01 Al2O3:0.25 MPP(OH)2:15 H2O

- Tetraethylorthosilicate (TEOS) was used as Si source
- GeO2 was used as Ge source
- Aluminium isopropoxide was used as Al source

Starting with 0.66 SiO2:0.33 GeO2:0.01 Al2O3:0.25 MPP(OH)2:15 H2O

Setting Si to 1.0:
- Si: 0.66 × 1 = 0.66, normalized to 1.0
- Ge: 0.33 × 1 = 0.33, normalized to 0.33/0.66 = 0.5
- Al: 0.01 × 2 = 0.02 (since Al2O3 has 2 Al atoms), normalized to 0.02/0.66 = 0.03
- OH: 0.25 × 2 = 0.5 (since MPP(OH)2 has 2 OH groups), normalized to 0.5/0.66 = 0.76
- H2O: 15, normalized to 15/0.66 = 22.73
